subject: Interim credit & timeline ask for delayed multimodal feature launch
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha.gupta@acmemedia.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laurie.chen@acmemedia.com, samir@acmemedia.com
Date: 2027-05-02T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multimodal launch - impact and ask

Diego / Marissa,

Quick note from the launch team: the multimodal model gating we expected to ship in April is now slipping to late May due to an integration regression related to image pre-processing. That means our marketing launch window for Acme Showcase (May 10) is at risk.

This delay creates a direct revenue impact for us and for our pilot customers — we estimated ~$45k of projected usage tied to the Showcase window. Procurement asked if Redwood can provide a temporary credit or rate accommodation for that usage window while the feature gap is resolved. We need a clear, timeboxed remediation plan and a one-off commercial accommodation to avoid churn with one of our marquee customers.

Attached is our internal impact summary (ACME_launch_impact_summary.pdf). Can you advise on what level of credit is feasible and whether this needs exec sign-off?

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Gupta
Head of Partnerships, Acme Media

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Multimodal launch - impact and ask

Laura / Karthik / Marissa — forwarding Acme's impact note. They call out a missed launch window tied to the multimodal gating delay (image preproc regression). They requested a temporary credit while we push the fix to late May.

Context: Product confirms a hotfix is in QA; target deploy is 2027-05-20. The loss is concentrated to the May 10 Showcase event and early pilot usage. Sales suggests a short-term commercial accommodation to preserve the account and avoid escalations into Exec.

Proposal (sales + product): offer a timeboxed usage credit equal to 40% of expected token/embedding spend for the 2-week Showcase period (estimate attached: proposed-credit-schedule.xlsx). This is intended as a goodwill bridge while the feature ships.

Ask: Laura — does finance have flexibility to approve a one-off credit of this size under an existing exec delegation, or should I route to Rishi for Exec sign-off? Karthik / Marissa — if we can confirm acceptance terms with Acme (date-bound, non-recurring), we can fast-track the doc.

I'm marking this urgent — Acme is a strategic pilot for our media vertical.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-credit-schedule.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-04T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Multimodal launch - impact and ask

Diego — thanks for the summary and for including the spreadsheet. Reviewed the numbers: the proposed 40% credit for a two-week window ($18k estimated revenue impact) is within the commercial goodwill band we can approve up to the Director level. Anything higher requires VP/Exec sign-off per policy.

Two quick items:
- We need a short amendment / commercial memo signed off by the AE (Karthik) and countersigned by Procurement to limit scope (dates, non-recurring).
- Finance prefers credits to be expressed as a dollar discount against monthly invoices rather than token reversals — simpler for accounting and audit.

If the customer agrees to the date-bound terms, I can issue the credit memo. If Karthik anticipates this needing to exceed the current estimate, please flag and I'll escalate to Rishi.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-05T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Multimodal launch - impact and ask

Team — brief update after a quick call with Acme. They accept a timeboxed commercial accommodation with the conditions Laura outlined (dollar credit on May invoice, covers May 8–21 usage, non-recurring). They will sign the short commercial memo and return it by EOD tomorrow.

Given Laura's confirmation that Director-level approval covers this amount, I'm authorizing the issuance once the signed memo is in. Laura — please prepare the credit memo and notify billing. Diego — pls confirm you have the signed doc and I will close the loop with Acme.

If anything changes and the actual impact exceeds the estimate materially, escalate to Rishi and I'll join the decision call.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
